paper_title: PowerBench: A Benchmark for Agentic Retrieval and Reasoning in Power Systems
reason: PowerBench는 재사용 가능한 에이전트 벤치마크이지만, 과제 언어가 한국어나 영어가 아니다. 논문 부록 B.7은 제시된 문항이 '고정된 중국어 문항(frozen Chinese stems)'을 영어로 의역한 것이라고 밝히며, 규칙 평가기도 중국어 지표명을 카탈로그에서 해석한다(부록 A.3.2). 실제 평가 문항과 문서가 중국어이므로 ko/en 트랙 범위 밖이다. 논문 본문이 영어라는 사실만으로 영어 트랙에 넣을 수 없으므로 제외한다.

screening.paper_title: PowerBench: A Benchmark for Agentic Retrieval and Reasoning in Power Systems
screening.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents offer new opportunities for automated analysis in industry. However, rigorous evaluation of such agents-for example, within power system scenarios-remains hindered: real operational data are confidential, and existing public resources fail to fully capture the chained dependencies and heterogeneous evidence. To address this gap, we propose PowerBench, comprising (1) a generation framework that derives interconnected heterogeneous operational data through a common dependency chain, and (2) a synthetic dataset generated by this framework. The dataset covers 761 devices across 100 device types, with 13.35 million hourly telemetry records spanning two years and 24,939 operational documents. Building on this dataset, we construct 300 questions across three task families that evaluate frontier LLMs' ability to complete analysis tasks that require autonomous evidence retrieval and reasoning across interconnected and heterogeneous data under restricted tool calls and time budgets. Results demonstrate that the evaluated frontier LLMs remain challenged on these tasks: the best model reaches only 74.2% joint accuracy. Our trace analysis further reveals that model performance varies across evidence discovery, content retrieval, tool use, reasoning over evidence, and answer submission. These findings provide detailed insights for evaluating LLM agents and guiding their reliable deployment in industry. The framework, dataset, and benchmark tasks are available at https://github.com/open-compass/PowerBench.
